summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of molten pool thermodynamics on the migration and distribution of AlN reinforcement in SLM-processed AlSi10Mg composites.
summary_en.method: A 3D CFD model was developed to simulate melt pool flow and particle transport during SLM.
summary_en.result: Convection and thermal gradients in the molten pool dominate the enrichment and distribution of AlN particles.
summary_en.validation: Simulation results were compared qualitatively with experimental metallographic observations.
